attributes.name: Acadamae Scholar
attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveal this card to recharge the ally Acadamae Student from your discard pile. 

Reveal this card to add 1 to your Arcane check.

Reveal this card to add 2 to your check against a card that has the Outsider trait.

Discard this card to explore your location.
